notes: Fetch results came through a page summarizer, so contact details and dates should be spot-checked before anything goes live. Verdicts: 13 publish, 1 hide (P Michael Boone Foundation, private, placeholder site), 1 out_of_area (Rainbow Reserve Project, Arizona). Four publish records are held back with no summary because nothing usable was found: Roots of Justice Inc (website domain does not resolve with or without www), Times of Refreshing (website field is a publisher name, not a URL), Trina Antoinette Adams Center for Keeping Children First and Organization for Africans with Disabilities (one search each, no matching group found). The two searches went to the two IRS groups with no web address that seemed most joinable, so Roots of Justice and Times of Refreshing were not searched and the search cap of 2 is fully spent. No rate limiting, no bot checks, no 403s; the only fetch failures were the Roots of Justice domain (DNS). Over the Goal Women Business Academy is dormant (newest dated item is fall 2023). Team Keep, We Love to Give and Resolve Philly are current. Eleven of the 15 batch groups had a working website that was read (one of them, P Michael Boone, is only a placeholder); Roots of Justice had a dead domain, and the other three had no web address.
